## Goal
Play a full round and use the new feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): In ShopUi.client.luau, scale-tween the panel in on open with a whoosh (GameAssets.play) and increment a shop_opened counter. On a successful buy, play the buy sound, flash the row green, tween a level bar fill, and increment shop_purchases. Buying must use the same server validation as the pads. If the player has too little cash, shake the row and play an error buzz. Use the existing GameAssets and UiTheme.. It has on-screen UI: use it like a player, through its buttons (`ui` + press): open its panel and press its action buttons (claim, buy, equip), and check what changed
